provenance.notes: api.iucnredlist.org and the Terms of Use answered 403 live on 2026-11-10 and were read in Wayback snapshots (2026-10-11, 2026-11-01). API page: a token is needed for every call (account); a rate-limiting system exists but no figure is published - "incorporate appropriate delays between your API calls" or the token may be further rate-limited or revoked; scraping is misuse; "Use of the Red List API for commercial purposes is strictly forbidden" (commercial users: an IBAT subscription); caching between Red List updates is recommended only after checking permission with the Red List team; full citation required, with the version. Terms (v3.1, June 2024): no commercial use of the data or derived works without IUCN's prior written permission; no reposting or redistribution of Red List data in whole or in part, including through web services or APIs, without a written waiver; use, download and print granted solely for conservation, education, scientific analysis and research; copies of publications to IUCN; superseded versions not to be used. The 0.5 s wait in this package's README/code is not stated on the pages read. Data are proprietary (no open licence).
